title: Ask holy company to hold you close
summary: Longing becomes steadier when companions draw one another close and speak of the Beloved together.
takeaway: Let longing be held in shared remembrance.
lifeApplication: When prayer thins into loneliness, reach for one companion who will remember with you rather than letting longing turn private and vague.

source.shortMeaning: The companions are called close so longing can speak of the Lord together, not struggle alone.
source.lifeApplication: Invite one truthful companion into remembrance before isolation teaches the heart to go quiet.

evidence.coreClaim: The companions are called close so longing can speak of the Lord together, not struggle alone.
evidence.turn: Holy company gives longing a shared voice instead of leaving it to fade privately.
evidence.practicalImplication: When prayer thins into loneliness, reach for one companion who will remember with you rather than letting longing turn private and vague.
